author: Axiom III
title: Improving the SOTA baseline: Bi-directional GRU Aggregator
abstract: Based on the conclusion that the 'collapsed' RNN-only model is the true SOTA, this experiment seeks to improve upon that baseline. The uni-directional GRU from the SOTA model is replaced with a Bi-directional GRU. The hypothesis is that capturing sequential dependencies from both forward and backward directions will create a more powerful representation and lead to a higher overall score. This submission marks a pivot away from the MoE framework towards refining the most effective single-path architecture.
